name: @npmpub2025/local-publish
description: A test package to demonstrate local publishing
author: Wes Todd <wes@wesleytodd.com>

scripts.prerelease: sh -c 'git pull --ff-only && npm test && npm version "${1:-patch}" && npm login'
scripts.postrelease: (npm logout || true) && git push --follow-tags && gh release create --draft --generate-notes "v$(cat package.json | jq -r .version)"
